story.text: 며칠 사이, 나는 이상한 걸 눈치챘다. 내가 가는 곳마다 신기하게 규현과 마주쳤다.
story.reading: myeo-chil sa-i, na-neun i-sang-han geol nun-chi-chaet-da. nae-ga ga-neun got-ma-da sin-gi-ha-ge gyu-hyeon-gwa ma-ju-chyeot-da.
story.en: Over the past few days, I noticed something strange. Wherever I went, Kyuhyun somehow kept showing up.

story.text: 홍대 골목에서도, 광장시장 앞에서도, 심지어 어제는 내가 예약한 게스트하우스 근처 편의점에서도 그를 봤다.
story.reading: hong-dae gol-mok-e-seo-do, gwang-jang-si-jang ap-e-seo-do, sim-ji-eo eo-je-neun nae-ga ye-yak-han ge-seu-teu-ha-u-seu geun-cheo pyeon-ui-jeom-e-seo-do geu-reul bwat-da.
story.en: In the alleys of Hongdae, in front of Gwangjang Market, and just yesterday even at a convenience store near the guesthouse I'd booked — I kept seeing him.

story.text: '이거 진짜 우연이에요? 아니면… 무슨 계획이라도 있는 거예요?' 나는 팔짱을 끼고 살짝 눈을 흘겼다.
story.reading: i-geo jin-jja u-yeon-i-e-yo? a-ni-myeon… mu-seun gye-hoeg-i-ra-do it-neun geo-ye-yo? na-neun pal-jjang-eul kki-go sal-jjak nun-eul heul-gyeot-da.
story.en: "Is this really a coincidence? Or... do you have some kind of plan?" I crossed my arms and shot him a suspicious look.

story.text: 그는 잠깐 멈칫하더니, 이내 특유의 능청스러운 미소를 지었다. '글쎄요, 제 발이 요즘 이상하게 이쪽으로만 오네요.'
story.reading: geu-neun jam-kkan meom-chit-ha-deo-ni, i-nae teuk-yu-ui neung-cheong-seu-reo-un mi-so-reul ji-eot-da. geul-sse-yo, je bal-i yo-jeum i-sang-ha-ge i-jjok-eu-ro-man o-ne-yo.
story.en: He paused for a second, then quickly slipped back into his signature smooth, unbothered smile. "Hmm, weird — my feet just keep bringing me this way lately."

story.text: '말도 안 되는 핑계라는 거, 저도 알아요. 근데 딱히 더 나은 변명이 생각이 안 나서요.'
story.reading: mal-do an doe-neun ping-gye-ra-neun geo, jeo-do al-a-yo. geun-de ttak-hi deo na-eun byeon-myeong-i saeng-gag-i an na-seo-yo.
story.en: "I know that's a ridiculous excuse. But I honestly can't think of a better one."

story.text: 장난스러운 말투였지만, 그 순간 그의 눈빛엔 숨기지 못한 진심이 살짝 스쳤다. 그는 곧바로 눈을 피하며 딴청을 부렸다.
story.reading: jang-nan-seu-reo-un mal-tu-yeot-ji-man, geu sun-gan geu-ui nun-bit-en sum-gi-ji mot-han jin-sim-i sal-jjak seu-chyeot-da. geu-neun got-ba-ro nun-eul pi-ha-myeo ttan-cheong-eul bu-ryeot-da.
story.en: His tone was playful, but for a moment his eyes betrayed a flicker of true feeling he couldn't quite hide. He quickly looked away and pretended to be busy with something else.

story.text: 뻔히 보이는 거짓말인데도, 이상하게 밉지가 않았다. 오히려, 그 서투른 발뺌이 조금 귀엽다고 생각했다.
story.reading: ppeon-hi bo-i-neun geo-jit-mal-in-de-do, i-sang-ha-ge mip-ji-ga an-at-da. o-hi-ryeo, geu seo-tu-reun bal-ppaem-i jo-geum gwi-yeop-da-go saeng-gak-haet-da.
story.en: It was an obvious lie, but strangely, I couldn't bring myself to be annoyed. If anything, I thought his clumsy dodge was kind of endearing.

words.meaning: to play it cool, act innocent

words.example_en: I don't believe that excuse at all.
I could see his true feelings in his eyes.

sentences.en: I don't believe that excuse at all.
I could see his true feelings in his eyes.
